slug: Toddler's First Guide to Good Manners
tagline: 50 Illustrated Lessons for Kids Ages 2–5 — Learn Please, Thank You, Sorry, Sharing, Taking Turns, Listening, Kindness & Everyday Good Behavior
title: Toddler's First Guide to Good Manners: 50 Illustrated Lessons for Kids Ages 2–5 — Learn Please, Thank You, Sorry, Sharing, Taking Turns, Listening, Kindness & Everyday Good Behavior
description:
A colorful 50-lesson illustrated children's book for toddlers and preschoolers. It teaches everyday manners and positive social skills through simple text, bright illustrations, and familiar situations. Topics include saying please, thank you, sorry, and excuse me; greeting and saying goodbye; sharing toys; taking turns; waiting patiently; listening; using kind words; asking permission; helping; cleaning up; eating politely; washing hands; covering a cough; respecting belongings and personal space; honesty; inclusion; gratitude; and kindness at home and school.

The listing presents the book as suitable for toddlers, preschoolers, kindergarten-age children, parent-child reading, classrooms, daycare, early-learning activities, and gifts.
